name: Quad Pong
hook: Four walls, four paddles, more balls. Last one in wins.
how: Slide your paddle along your wall and bounce every ball away. Let one past and you lose a life; lose all 3 and your wall closes. A new ball joins every 15 seconds.
controls: Mouse or ← → to slide your paddle · touch: drag
uses: One player's browser moves the balls and counts lives, so everyone sees the same bounces; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots guard every empty wall, and take over the wall of anyone who leaves.
Every paddle and ball moves for everyone at once.
ideas: Make the paddles shrink each time you lose a life
Add a power-up ball that splits in two
Turn it into an ice rink with pucks
